Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-07-31 · App: NativeCode (com.zenithblue.nativecode)

NativeCode is a developer environment that runs a Linux guest (PRoot/Chroot), an optional X11 desktop, terminal sessions and optional third-party AI CLIs. This policy describes how information is handled when you use the Android app.

01

Summary

  • ▸NativeCode is local-first. We do not collect personal data on a NativeCode cloud or backend.
  • ▸Your files, projects, packages and credentials stay on this device — inside the Debian PRoot or Chroot distro and app-private storage.
  • ▸Optional features (GitHub login, AI CLI auth, package and marketplace installs) may contact third parties you choose — never a NativeCode analytics service.
  • ▸Auth tokens and credentials, when used, are stored on-device only.

02

Information on your device

  • ▸App preferences — isolation method (PRoot/Chroot), UI and settings flags.
  • ▸Linux guest data — Debian rootfs, packages, home-directory files and projects you create.
  • ▸Auth material (optional) — GitHub CLI tokens, AI CLI API keys or device-login sessions under guest home.
  • ▸Session state — terminal history, project paths, onboarding progress.
  • ▸This data is under your control. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes app-owned data (subject to OS backup rules).

03

Information sent over the network

  • ▸Guest packages and tools — Debian/apt mirrors, marketplace or AI installer hosts, only when you install.
  • ▸GitHub authentication and API — github.com, only when you connect GitHub.
  • ▸AI CLI install or auth — official vendor endpoints for the tools you enable.
  • ▸Package managers — npm registry, apt repositories, only when you install tools.
  • ▸We do not sell personal information. Third parties process data under their own privacy policies.

04

Permissions

  • ▸NativeCode may request Android permissions for its features — e.g. notifications for foreground services that keep terminal and AI sessions alive, and network access. Permissions are used only for the stated in-app purpose.

05

Sharing

  • ▸We do not sell or rent your data. Data leaves the device only when you authenticate to a third party, install remote packages you chose, or when a tool you run makes its own network calls.

06

Retention & deletion

  • ▸Local app and guest data is kept until you delete it, clear storage, or uninstall.
  • ▸Tokens and keys are kept until you sign out, overwrite config, clear guest home, clear app data, or uninstall.
  • ▸In-app: Settings → GitHub Account → LOGOUT, AI CLI tools → per-tool LOGOUT or CLEAR ALL AI CREDENTIALS, or clear app storage from Android App info.
  • ▸For account data held by GitHub or AI vendors, manage deletion in those services' own settings.

07

Security

  • ▸Traffic to third parties uses HTTPS where supported. Credentials live in app and guest storage — protect your device with a lock screen.
  • ▸OS backup behavior (allowBackup) may copy app files depending on device settings — treat device backups as sensitive if you store tokens.

08

Children's privacy

  • ▸NativeCode is a developer tool intended for adults and professional use. It is not directed at children under 13 (or the age required by local law).

09

AI-generated content

  • ▸Optional AI CLIs run as third-party tools inside the guest environment. You are responsible for how you use them and for complying with each vendor's terms.
  • ▸In-app: Settings → AI Safety & Report — vendor terms links, report forms and a developer report path (zenithblue.dev@gmail.com).

10

Changes & contact

  • ▸We may update this policy in the repository; the Last updated date will change.
  • ▸Questions: zenithblue.dev@gmail.com — or open an issue at github.com/zenithblue-dev/nativecode-ai.
